verdicts.reason: A does use the banner's left-to-right flow, but the headline is far too big. It breaks over two lines and nearly touches the top and bottom edges. The CTA is squeezed into a four-line stack ('Shop / the / Summer / Line') with 'the' left on its own line, it sits tight to the right edge, and a background dot overlaps it. The logo is tiny and isolated, so the three groups feel jammed together with uneven spacing. B is clean and on brand, with nothing colliding and a clear hierarchy, but it is just the square stacked centrally in a strip. It doesn't use the wide format, the logo and CTA are small at this size, and the left and right thirds are left empty.
